properties.NAME: ISLAND (Wa.)
properties.CHANGE: ISLAND (Wa.) created by Oregon Territory from THURSTON (Wa.). ISLAND included the disputed San Juan Islands which were claimed by both the United States and Great Britain from 15 January 1846 to 21 October 1872.
properties.CITATION: (Ore. Terr. Laws, special, 1852, 4th reg. sess., pp. 46-47)
